headline: Arun Purushottam Kelkar appointed as Executive Director and Chairman of Hexagon Nutrition
summary: Hexagon Nutrition Limited has announced the appointment of Mr. Arun Purushottam Kelkar as Executive Director and Chairman of the company. The appointment is effective from October 28, 2026. This corporate governance update establishes new leadership for the company going forward.
why_it_matters: New leadership takes charge at Hexagon Nutrition in 2026.

headline: Hexagon Nutrition submits scrutinizer report and voting results
hook: Routine shareholder voting results filed at exchange
summary: Hexagon Nutrition Limited has submitted its scrutinizer report and voting results to the stock exchange following a recent shareholder meeting held on October 28, 2026. These procedural filings detail the outcome of resolutions put to shareholders during the meeting. Such corporate disclosures are routine administrative requirements for listed entities. Indian retail investors tracking this micro-cap company should note the procedural compliance, though the filing lacks immediate financial impact.
why_it_matters: Procedural compliance filing with no immediate stock price impact

headline: Hexagon Nutrition schedules Extraordinary General Meeting for October 28, 2026
summary: Hexagon Nutrition Limited has submitted a formal notice to the exchange regarding an upcoming Extraordinary General Meeting. The meeting of shareholders is scheduled to take place on October 28, 2026. Specific agenda details for the EGM were not disclosed in the initial exchange filing. Retail investors holding shares in the company should monitor subsequent disclosures for the meeting's agenda items.
why_it_matters: Corporate decisions at the EGM may impact shareholder value.
